node.title: Re: How to escape single quote(s) without the use of quotemeta
node.author: hippo
node.doctext:
Is this what you are after?

use strict; use warnings; use Test::More tests => 1; my $have = "This sting it's bothering to escape ' single characters"; my $want = "This sting it\\'s bothering to escape \\' single characters"; $have =~ s/'/\\'/g; is $have, $want;
